req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /health/ endpoint should respond with sub-second latency and no external dependencies, returning an HTTP 2xx status code. The test suite will include a positive test to verify the expected behavior, a negative test to simulate a client error, and a boundary test to ensure the endpoint handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint.
expected: The response time is less than 1 second.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)
start_time = time.time()
response = client.get('/health/')
end_time = time.time()

assert response.status_code == 200
assert (end_time - start_time) < 1

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /health/invalid.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint with a large number of concurrent requests.
expected: All responses have a status code of 200.
All responses are received within 1 second.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)
start_time = time.time()
responses = [client.get('/health/') for _ in range(100)]
end_time = time.time()

assert all(response.status_code == 200 for response in responses)
assert (end_time - start_time) < 1
